gloss_en: Faith (emunah) — the noun אֱמוּנָה: belief/trust in God and His providence, the spiritual faculty of faith (identified in Likutey Moharan with prayer, malchut, the Land of Israel, Shabbat, and the rectified imagination); not אֻמָּנוּת (craft), אָמְנָה (pact), or אֹמְנָה (nurture/guardianship) as independent senses — even where the 'omen/nurturing' etymology (וַיְהִי אֹמֵן אֶת הֲדַסָּה) is cited, it is invoked as an aspect of emunah itself
